NewsArticle.Title: Version 3.5
NewsArticle.Content: at 7 a.m. PDT Some new features will appear immediately and others will be finished later in May, in June, and in July. Check [www.darkages.com/news](http://www.darkages.com/news) for new feature details and schedules. Installation Support But first, you will need to download the full client one time, because the auto-update system itself has been enhanced. After this one-time download, you can auto-update. - Wait until 00.05.10 at 7 a.m. PDT - Uninstall Dark Ages 2.27 - [Download](http://www.darkages.com/2000/download) full Dark Ages 3.5 (it will not be available until the download page reads: Version 3.50) [www.darkages.com/download](http://www.darkages.com/download) - Install Dark Ages 3.5 If you have any problem: [www.darkages.com/support/support.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/support.htm)
